title: erigeron angustatus
intro: Erigeron angustatus, commonly known as the narrow-leaved daisy or narrowleaf fleabane, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help soothe wounds and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron angustatus include its ability to reduce fever, treat respiratory issues, and act as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
